name: Keep an AI tool register up to date in Google Sheets (AI Leakage)

parameters.content:
## Keep an AI tool register up to date in Google Sheets
Many businesses keep a list of the AI tools their staff use. Every Monday this fills in, for each tool on your list, the address of its AI Leakage profile, when the profile was last re-read against the vendor's own documents, and the date of the last checked change.

**Set up (3 minutes)**
1. Make a Google Sheet with a tab called **Tools** and a column headed **Tool** (one tool per row, e.g. ChatGPT, Canva Magic Studio, Xero). Add empty columns: AI Leakage page, Last re-read at source, Last checked change, Updated by workflow.
2. Paste the sheet's address into both Google Sheets nodes and add your Google credential.
3. Activate. Tools we don't cover show 'Not covered yet'.

Data: AI Leakage, CC BY 4.0. No ratings or scores. General information, not legal advice.
